description: Search the MCP Yellow Pages measured catalog — the entry point for finding an MCP server. Give a plain task description ('send email', 'stock prices', 'github issues') and get servers ranked by content match, then by independently measured quality (liveness, deep-test results, tool counts). Every result was actually probed by MCPYP. Usual flow: find_mcp to discover candidates, then get_mcp to inspect one, then get_config to connect. requires_key tells you whether the server needs a publisher API key before use. Set no_key_required=true to return only servers verified usable without a publisher API key (a successful keyless call on record).

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 10, max 100

no_key_required.description: Only servers verified usable without a publisher API key (a successful keyless call on record)

query.description: What the MCP should do, e.g. 'send email', 'stock prices', 'github issues'

name: find_mcp
